plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 4-date timeline completes: Aug–Oct 1929 & 1939 (Karl Lohmann and Cyrus Fiske & Yellapragada SubbaRow isolate ATP from muscle; Engelhardt & Lyubimova prove myosin is an ATPase enzyme) · 1941–1942 (Albert Szent-Györgyi & Brunó Straub in Szeged discover actin and make actomyosin threads contract in a dish with ATP) · 22 May 1954 (Andrew Huxley & Rolf Niedergerke at Cambridge and Hugh Huxley & Jean Hanson at MIT publish back-to-back papers in Nature proving the Sliding Filament Theory) · 1957–1971 (Hugh Huxley images myosin cross-bridges; Setsuro Ebashi discovers the calcium-troponin switch; Lymn & Taylor map the 4-step ATP cross-bridge cycle).
